subject: New subprocessor add — gating checklist & DocuSign stub
messages:
From: Ellen Martin <ellen.martin@cloudwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.com, legal@cloudwave.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New subprocessor add + onboarding evidence request

Hi Jordan,

Quick heads up — CloudWave is planning to engage a small analytics subcontractor (BrightLayer Inc.) to handle anonymized telemetry enrichment for our integration. Per our MSA, we know Redwood needs to confirm subprocessor flow-down and evidence for the DPA. Attached is a one-page statement from BrightLayer (EXHIBIT-A_Subprocessor_List.pdf) and the proposed subcontractor scope.

Can you confirm the gating list Redwood requires for onboard approval (e.g., DPA annex, SOC2 extract, encryption attest) and whether DocuSign stub paperwork is acceptable for initial SOW execution while we collect full evidence? We need to hit an internal go-live window in mid-July.

Thanks —
Ellen Martin
CloudWave — Vendor Ops
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Martin <ellen.martin@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New subprocessor add + onboarding evidence request

Thanks Ellen — looping in Legal and Procurement to confirm required evidence and process. High level from ops side: we need (1) DPA annex / flow-down language accepted by Redwood legal; (2) SOC 2 Type II or equivalent audit evidence for BrightLayer; (3) data handling diagram + retention TTL; and (4) a signed order form or DocuSign stub that references the MSA clause on subcontracting.

Kimberly / Connor — can you advise if a DocuSign "stub" with a statement of intent is sufficient to let CloudWave start engineering work, or do we require completed evidence before any onboarding access is granted? If partial acceptance is possible, please list gating items we can waive temporarily and the maximum holdback window.

-Jordan
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ellen Martin <ellen.martin@cloudwave.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New subprocessor add + onboarding evidence request

Jordan / team — thanks. I reviewed the supplied EXHIBIT-A and BrightLayer's one-pager. Quick take:

- We require a signed DPA annex flowdown that includes data residency and logging obligations. A DocuSign stub is acceptable only if it binds BrightLayer to the exact flow-down clauses and includes a specific remediation SLA and evidence delivery timeline.
- Minimum evidence: SOC 2 Type II OR an ISO 27001 certificate plus a completed security questionnaire (we have a shortened template).
- Operational gating: no production access until we have (a) proof of encryption-at-rest, (b) incident notification contact, and (c) completed minimum SSO integration checklist. Temporary dev/test access can be granted with a limited token and IP-restricted VPN.

Connor — can Procurement sign off on a conditional order form that references the MSA and includes a 30-day evidence delivery milestone? Marissa — ops will need the SSO/integration playbook to evaluate access controls.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Martin <ellen.martin@cloudwave.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New subprocessor add + onboarding evidence request

We can do the conditional order form. Proposed commercial mechanics: CloudWave executes an order form stub (DocuSign link below) that references the MSA and lists BrightLayer as an approved subprocessor pending evidence delivery within 30 calendar days. If evidence isn't received by day 30, fees tied to BrightLayer's work will be withheld until remediation. That should be acceptable for their procurement team.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/link/ABC-CloudWave-Subproc-Stub

I'll draft the simple conditional language and send to Kimberly for redline by EOD. Connor
From: Ellen Martin <ellen.martin@cloudwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New subprocessor add + onboarding evidence request

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We will accept a conditional order form with a 30-day evidence window. BrightLayer can provide SOC 2 in progress (expected audit completion Oct) — they will send an interim security questionnaire and an encryption attestation immediately. We will upload supporting artifacts to the shared Drive link (https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/CWS-94/evidence-bucket).

Separately, I attached an editable redline of the order form that reflects the two helpful clauses we discussed (redlines_orderform_v2.docx). Please route back with any legal tweaks.

—Ellen
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ellen Martin <ellen.martin@cloudwave.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New subprocessor add + onboarding evidence request

Team — I redlined the order form and added a short DPA annex paragraph to the DocuSign stub that requires BrightLayer to adhere to our data handling and breach notification timelines. Key items I added: explicit chain-of-custody clause, a 30-day evidence delivery milestone, and a limited-scope dev token policy for provisional access.

Ellen — please ask BrightLayer to complete the attached short security questionnaire and upload it to the Drive link. Once we have the questionnaire + encryption attestation, Procurement can countersign the stub and Ops will issue a limited dev token while we await SOC 2. If any evidence is missing at day 30 Procurement will pause billing and revoke access until clearance.

I'll put the final redline in DocuSign tomorrow morning.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redlines_orderform_v2.docx
